ops.title: Bound cache metadata work across fresh CLI processes
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccn_bounded_cache. ops.text: New CLI cache write and hit perform no cache corpus walk; CI traces actual 32 and 10000 entry cases with bounded metadata syscall growth.
LRU promotion, exact capacity, cross-process concurrency, crash publication and derived-cache error behavior pass independent review and race CI; large entries remain streamed.
Merged release is installed under root serialization and affected fresh CLI operation is measured against unchanged body and metadata bounds.
